subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Beliefs or incidents that happen in a way which cannot be explained by reason or science.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Superstitions"** means beliefs or incidents that happen in a way which cannot be explained by reason or science. (अंधविश्वास)

 
 
• **Example: **Many people still believe in **superstitions**, like avoiding walking under a ladder for fear of bad luck.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Marvels **(चमत्कार): Wonderful or astonishing things.

 
 
• **Example:** The technological marvels of the modern world are truly impressive.
 
 
 
• **Wonders **(आश्चर्य): Things that cause astonishment or admiration.
 
 
• **Example:** The wonders of nature never cease to amaze us.
 
 
 
• **Science totems **(विज्ञान प्रतीक): Not a widely recognized term.
 
 
• **Example:** This term does not have a widely accepted example.
